question: What are the two actual options of the Crested Porcupine Digging 2 ability illustrated in the rules, and how many selections does it provide?
expected_answer: Make 2 selections. One option is to discard 1 card from the display and replenish the display. The other option is to discard 1 card from your hand and draw 1 card from the deck.
material_requested_facts: One option is to discard 1 card from the display and replenish the display.
The other option is to discard 1 card from your hand and draw 1 card from the deck.
source_references: Main p13 Crested Porcupine illustrated Digging 2 text; Glossary p2 Digging (choice-by-choice timing remains Q42)
origin: Independent challenge F04; original Q42 preserved by parent instruction
distinct_novelty: Q42 asks whether choices can differ and refill timing, but never asks what the choices are; this adds the actual card sources/destinations, not another choice-timing example.

question: When replenishing the display, how do remaining cards fill gaps, must their order be preserved, and how are the final empty folders filled?
expected_answer: Move remaining cards from higher-numbered folders down into the lower gaps. Preserve the relative order of those cards. Then fill each remaining empty folder with a card from the deck.
material_requested_facts: Move remaining cards from higher-numbered folders down into the lower gaps.
Preserve the relative order of those cards.
Then fill each remaining empty folder with a card from the deck.
source_references: Main p9 The Reputation Track and the Display, paragraph beginning If you have taken one or more cards from the display
origin: Independent challenge F07 and proposed Q06 amendment; Q06 preserved by parent instruction
distinct_novelty: Q06 tests refill timing, while Q42 mentions normal shift/refill but never requests preservation of relative order and final deck fill; this adds the explicit ordered compaction procedure.

question: For the Species Diversity base conservation project illustrated in the rules, what is counted, do repeated icons of one animal category increase that count, and which category counts give which conservation rewards?
expected_answer: Count different animal-category icons in your zoo, rather than all copies of those icons; repeated copies of one category do not add another different category. Bear and Petting Zoo animal are animal categories; continent and research icons are not. The illustrated tiers are 5, 4 or 3 different animal categories for 5, 3 or 2 conservation points respectively; choose a fulfilled unoccupied tier under the normal support rules.
material_requested_facts: Count different animal-category icons in your zoo, rather than all copies of those icons; repeated copies of one category do not add another different category.
Bear and Petting Zoo animal are animal categories; continent and research icons are not.
The illustrated tiers are 5, 4 or 3 different animal categories for 5, 3 or 2 conservation points respectively; choose a fulfilled unoccupied tier under the normal support rules.
source_references: Main p2 Species Diversity base-project illustration; Main p7 Species Diversity illustration; Main p13 animal categories; Main p15 normal support conditions
distinct_novelty: A distinct-category project is a different counting rule from ordinary total-icon projects. One question covers the complete tier table, without numerical scenario variants.

question: Which side faces up when a standard enclosure is built, and when and how often do you gain the placement bonuses of the spaces it covers?
expected_answer: Place the newly built standard enclosure with its empty side up, identified by its yellow edge and enclosure-size number. Gain the corresponding placement bonus immediately when its space is covered, once only; if several bonus spaces are covered, gain each corresponding bonus. When building multiple buildings, resolve the first building placement bonuses before placing the next building.
material_requested_facts: Place the newly built standard enclosure with its empty side up, identified by its yellow edge and enclosure-size number.
Gain the corresponding placement bonus immediately when its space is covered, once only; if several bonus spaces are covered, gain each corresponding bonus.
When building multiple buildings, resolve the first building placement bonuses before placing the next building.
source_references: Main p10 Build I empty-side and placement-bonus paragraphs; Main p6 Your Zoo Map placement-bonus paragraph; Main p10 Build II sequential building paragraph
distinct_novelty: The general newly built enclosure state and once-only placement-bonus activation were not requested earlier. Sequential funding is existing context, not credited as new novelty.
